calculate_edit_distance: calculate the edit distance between two lists of tokens using dynamic programming
compute_ter_score: compute the Translated Edit Rate score for a hypothesis against a single reference sentence
compute_ter_with_multiple_refs: compute the Translated Edit Rate score for a hypothesis against multiple reference sentences
